statement.text:
Two groups G1 and G2 are said to be commensurable if there exist finite-
index subgroups H1 ⩽ G1 and H2 ⩽ G2 (not necessarily of the same index) such that
H1 ∼= H2 . Let A[F4 ] and A[H4 ] denote the Artin groups of spherical types F4 and H4 ,
respectively. Are these two groups commensurable? This is the most difficult case in
the classification of Artin groups of spherical type up to commensurability. I. Soroko
